requirements.evidence: All endpoints, middleware and command are present: routes/api.php:9-15 (throttle:10,1 / throttle:30,1), TotemAuthController.php:23-25 (400 invalid_code_format), :34-39 (single 401 for unknown/expired/consumed/inactive), :28-31 lockForUpdate in DB::transaction, :86-91 entity pair; TotemAuth.php:91-106 (entity mismatch + intersection of claim and current preset queues); TotemController.php:155-163 (404 within entity, 403 out of scope), :73-75 inactive_queue, :98-100 invalid_priority, :103 reuses IssueTicket with TicketChannel::Totem; bootstrap/app.php:34-40 rate_limited render; config/cors.php:22-24; phpunit.xml:44-45; docs updated. Small edge gaps: TotemPairingCode.php:37-43 can hit the unique index on login_code (another preset's stale consumed code) and crash instead of retrying; queue description/visual hardcoded (TotemController.php:51-56), though documented.

conventions.evidence: Domain write goes through App\Actions\IssueTicket (TotemController.php:103); models use #[Fillable] deliberately (Totem.php:11, TotemPreset.php:12-20); migration has reversible down() (migration:47-52); docs/api/totem.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database-schema.md synced. Deviations: CHANGELOG.md not updated under [Unreleased] as conventions require; migration name 2026_10_29_000001_create_totem_tables looks hand-named rather than generated by make:migration.

security.evidence: JWT verification uses hash_equals and pins alg HS256 (TotemJwt.php:66-72), checks exp (:80-88); path entity/queue never trusted (TotemController.php:131-133, 150-163); pairing failures share one 401 and logs mask the code (TotemAuthController.php:66-71); CORS no credentials (cors.php:32). Gap: TotemJwt::secret() falls back to '' (TotemJwt.php:19) and nothing rejects an empty/short secret, while .env.example ships TOTEM_JWT_SECRET= empty, so a deployment missing the env var would sign and accept tokens with an empty HMAC key (forgeable).

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php covers command success/failure (:50-69), 400 formats incl. empty/int (:71-81), all 401 pairing cases (:83-106), success + single-use replay (:108-147), invalid/expired token, inactive totem/preset, entity mismatch (:149-226), last_seen_at (:228-236), queue listing/order/scope revocation (:238-277), 403/404/422 paths (:293-345, :384-408), sequential A001/A002 with channel totem (:347-382), CORS (:410-437), pairing 429 (:439-450). Missing: the 30/min ticket throttle, tampered-signature/alg-none token, audit logging. Global $ip counter via `global` in a Pest file is fragile.

simplicity.evidence: Lean controllers with shared context()/resolveQueue() helpers; reuses IssueTicket and framework HandleCors via config/cors.php. Small HS256 implementation is allowed by the task. Minor excess: services.totem.web_origin is defined (config/services.php:46) but unused (cors.php reads env directly); ->withCommands([TotemPairingCode::class]) in bootstrap/app.php:42 is redundant with app/Console/Commands auto-discovery.

readability.evidence: Clear class docblocks (TotemAuth.php:13-27, TotemController.php:16-22), small focused methods, explicit contract codes. Union return array|JsonResponse with instanceof checks (TotemController.php:29-31, 66-68) is slightly awkward; test helper uses `global $ip` (TotemApiTest.php:15-23).

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: models, migration, factories, command, middleware, controllers, routes, CORS config, env/phpunit pins, the three docs the task names, and one feature test file. No unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The secret falls back to an empty string with no guard, and .env.example leaves TOTEM_JWT_SECRET empty, so a misconfigured environment would issue and accept tokens signed with an empty key that anyone can forge; it should fail closed when the secret is missing or too short.
A random code that matches another preset's still-stored login_code (consumed or active) violates the unique index and crashes the command; there is no retry on collision.
Conventions require a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] for the change; none is in the diff.
No test for the 30/min ticket throttle, for a token with a tampered signature or a non-HS256 alg header, or for the pairing audit log entries.
The filename timestamp (000001) suggests the migration was hand-written instead of generated with make:migration, as the conventions require.
services.totem.web_origin is never read; config/cors.php calls env('TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN') directly.
withCommands([TotemPairingCode::class]) is redundant because commands in app/Console/Commands are auto-discovered.
The per-test IP counter relies on `global $ip` inside a Pest file whose top level is not truly global scope; this works only by accident (null++).

review.summary: The change implements the full totem BFF: pairing command, atomic code-for-JWT login, a JWT middleware that intersects the claim and preset scope, the queues, priorities and ticket endpoints reusing IssueTicket, CORS, and rate_limited rendering, with broad feature tests and synced docs. It is close to mergeable, but the JWT layer accepts an empty secret, which is a fail-open risk if the env var is missing. Smaller gaps: pairing-code collisions aren't handled, CHANGELOG isn't updated, and a few test cases are missing, so it needs changes before merging.
